U.note: Logic and phase handling are sound, but an inline font-size:inherit on the h1 shrinks the clock to body size, so the one thing that matters is tiny, and the clock is aria-hidden.

V.note: Attractive card with ring and tabs, drift-free countdown and correct auto-advance, but includes settings, has no live region, no aria-pressed on tabs and no skip or shortcuts.

W.note: Bold full-bleed colour per phase and huge clock with excellent a11y and shortcuts, but padded with auto-start, chime toggle, notifications, progress bar and skip.

X.note: Polished dark card with ring, but Skip counts a pomodoro as done, Space on a focused button toggles the timer, no live region, and settings add bulk.

Y.note: Lean and complete: huge clock, phase colour and dots, timestamp-based countdown, a polite live region, a timer role, Space shortcut, and a clear pause, reset and phase change.

Z.note: Large clear clock with phase colours, dots, shortcuts and notification, solid logic; slightly extra with a clear-count confirm and notifications, and a done phase colour that never appears.
